name: dayglance
description: Read and manage your dayGLANCE schedule, tasks, goals, and projects. All data stays on your machine.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the dayGLANCE app running on this computer. Claude can read your day and week, your inbox, the Bucket List, and your goals, projects and areas, and can create, schedule, move, resize and complete tasks, manage subtasks, and create and update goals and projects. Every change can be undone in dayGLANCE, and nothing can be deleted or archived from Claude. Enable the MCP server in dayGLANCE under Settings, then Local Integrations. Direct-download builds of dayGLANCE are discovered automatically. If you installed dayGLANCE from the Mac App Store, copy the token from the same settings screen into the Token field here.

token.title: dayGLANCE MCP token
token.description: Only needed for Mac App Store installs of dayGLANCE. Copy it from dayGLANCE Settings, then Local Integrations. Direct-download builds are discovered automatically and can leave this empty.

port.title: Port
port.description: The MCP server port shown in dayGLANCE Settings. Leave at 7893 unless you changed it there.
